entries.title: Crewmates write tests only for what you asked for
entries.body: A crewmate now writes a test only for something you asked for, a standing rule of yours, or a bug it is fixing, and it treats a failing test as a possible bug before changing the test. If your project's own instructions say how tests are written and run, the crewmate follows those instead.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the change is in which tests a crewmate writes and how it repairs them.
